import numpy as np

def inpainting(original_image, mask, model, prompt, steps=50):
    z_orig = vae_encoder(original_image)
    T = 1000
    steps_list = np.linspace(0, T - 1, steps, dtype=int)[::-1]
    z = np.random.randn(*z_orig.shape)
    text_embed = clip_encode(prompt)
    for i, t in enumerate(steps_list):
        eps_cond = model(z, t, text_embed)
        eps_uncond = model(z, t, np.zeros_like(text_embed))
        eps = eps_uncond + 7.5 * (eps_cond - eps_uncond)
        ab = alpha_bar[t]
        ab_prev = alpha_bar[steps_list[i + 1]] if i + 1 < len(steps_list) else alpha_bar[0]
        z_gen = np.sqrt(ab_prev) * (z - np.sqrt(1 - ab) * eps) / np.sqrt(ab) + np.sqrt(1 - ab_prev) * eps
        z_orig_noisy = np.sqrt(ab_prev) * z_orig + np.sqrt(1 - ab_prev) * np.random.randn(*z_orig.shape)
        z = mask * z_gen + (1 - mask) * z_orig_noisy
    return vae_decoder(z)
